messages:
sara: FYI — following the postmortem, we need to track follow-ups on the edge gateway TLS handshake spikes and cross-region retry storms. Putting a quick owners/timelines list here so we can triage.

mike: thanks. can someone paste the sample handshake error logs again? that will help confirm if it's the same pattern we saw in feb.

jonathan: pasting a trimmed log from last night:
```
[2026-03-22T02:14:33Z] tcp_handshake_timeout conn_id=0x7f8a error=TLS handshake failed: alert handshake_failure (remote: us-west-2-edge)
[2026-03-22T02:14:33Z] retry_attempt=1 route=gw-aws-usw2 -> gw-aws-use1 latency_ms=120
[2026-03-22T02:14:33Z] retry_attempt=2 route=gw-aws-use1 -> gw-aws-eu1 latency_ms=220
```
jonathan: seems like initial TLS failure then cross-region fallback, which increases token latency and triggers client retries.

linh: adding observation: SNI mismatch logs show approx 18% of failures during the window had mismatched SNI on egress to partner LB. snippet: `match_sni: expected=redwood.prod actual=redwood-prd`

ashley: good catch. I think this ties to the recent egress config roll (rollout ID 7731). @mike can you confirm whether the rollout touched SNI templating?

mike: yes — rollout 7731 changed SNI templating to use short-hostnames for that cluster, but we didn't have a regression test for older partner LB configs. that's on me.

incident-bot: Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/2026-03-edge-handshake — summary + RCA uploaded. :spiral_notepad:

sara: OK action items (initial, rough ETAs) — please ack and update ownership here: 
- A1: Add SNI regression unit/integration tests for partner LB patterns (owner: mike) — ETA 2026-03-28
- A2: Revert short-hostname SNI change on canary clusters until tests pass (owner: devops-oncall) — ETA 2h
- A3: Add metric + alert for handshake_failure rate >0.5% / 5m (owner: linh) — ETA 2026-03-24
- A4: Add a routing policy to avoid cross-region fallback for transient TLS handshake failures (owner: jonathan) — ETA 2026-04-02
- A5: Run a 72h smoke with partner LB test matrix and collect retry histograms (owner: ashley) — ETA 2026-03-30

mike: ACK A1, on it. I'll push a unit test + an integration harness using the partner's cert vectors.

devops-oncall: ACK A2 — rolling revert to canary now. posting deploy log: `deploy revert 7731 -> canary clusters`

linh: small correction on A3 owner field: it's `linh` (one word). I'll create the alert and a dashboard tile. ETA end of day tomorrow.

jonathan: A4: proposed approach — change routing policy so that a single handshake_failure does not trigger full cross-region failover. Implement exponential backoff + one local retry with extended timeout. I'll prototype and share config diff by end of week.

ashley: A5 ack. I'll coordinate with partner infra to run the test matrix. need a list of LB versions they still support — mike can you share?

mike: sending the supported LB versions in the postmortem comments.

sara: two follow-up governance items: 1) assign a recurring audit for SNI templating whenever we change egress config; 2) add the handshake_failure pattern to the recurring incident playbook list (so it surfaces in runbooks). I want these done by next sprint.

jonathan: noted for runbook. also flagging that this pattern has appeared 3x in last 9 months (see incident history), so we should mark it as a recurring class and consider a longer-term design fix.

mike: quick patch: I'll add a compatibility mode toggle guarded by feature flag so we can revert behavior without deploy churn. planning to ship toggle + tests by 3/28.

devops-oncall: revert completed on canary, monitoring now. early metrics look stable. will report in 30m.

ashley: leaving a note — I'll create the partner test schedule doc and invite their infra. link will go in the postmortem.

sara: great. please update the PM ticket with owner+ETA changes and mark items with blockers if any. I'll run a 10m sync tomorrow to close open questions. :thumbsup:

mike: one more: logging tweak request — include negotiated TLS version and cipher in handshake metrics so we can correlate failures with specific ciphers. put in A6?

linh: A6 accepted (owner: linh) — adding fields to telemetry pipeline. ETA 2026-03-26.

jonathan: thanks — also adding a short note to rollout playbook: "do not change SNI formatting without compatibility tests for external LBs".

sara: thanks everyone. update the ticket as you go and add short notes to the runbook. I'll close this thread after the 10m tomorrow and create a follow-up if we hit regressions. :eyes:
